crafted_items.label: Steel Longsword
crafted_items.description: A steel-forged longsword with a keen edge. The standard of any professional soldier.

crafted_items.label: Iron Plate Cuirass
crafted_items.description: A sturdy iron cuirass forged to protect the torso. Heavy but reliable.

crafted_items.label: Ruby-Engraved Steel Longsword
crafted_items.description: A steel longsword with a ruby set into the crossguard. The gem's fire phase overwrites the blade's metal element, making it interact as Fire in Wuxing cycles.

crafted_items.label: Sapphire-Engraved Elven Bow
crafted_items.description: An elven wood longbow engraved with a sapphire. The bow's natural Wood phase is overwritten by the sapphire's Water phase. Frost arrows fired from this bow benefit from the generating cycle (Water feeds Wood).

crafted_items.label: Poisoned Obsidian Dagger
crafted_items.description: An obsidian dagger with a burn enchantment and temporary coatings (paralytic poison + stamina drain). The Fire phase of the blade interacts with the Earth-phase stamina-drain coating via Wuxing cycles. See crafting_reference.py --verbose for exact interaction output.

crafted_items.label: Enchanted Gold Amulet
crafted_items.description: A gold amulet engraved with a diamond, carrying a permanent ward enchantment. Gold's high effectMagnitude (0.30) amplifies the resist effect, and the diamond's Metal phase gives it full generating-cycle benefit for the Metal-phase resist.
